name: Gitifact
description: Turn GitHub HTML files into live artifacts. Preview HTML files directly on GitHub without deploying.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-modals; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data: blob: https:; img-src data: blob: https: http:; font-src data: blob: https:; media-src data: blob: https:; connect-src data: blob: https:; frame-src data: blob: about: https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
